translation.name: YISU KILISI ANE BINGE VIE GIENGK IWAL AVOS

content: Bingai gipil amol ebe gidawi ben uve ok

Kob Yisu gilumul gile be gibul amolmol vukuri gibweg alus den gibloblo bui kapul Galilaia vukuri, be amolmol anongge molge iro isate sut itangi ei ile love ivarkei ile isung-sungi ei ge. Beti Yisu gipil eivovo ti gile gibweg be isu ei tis eivovo nok gile givwev aikawe kasop gege gikwai alus, be amolmol tepwengge ivarkei ebe alus ok.
Yisu geb yaun anongge gitangi eisir be ginei gipil bingai ge be ginei;
“Unaute kob. Amol ti gile ve nindawi ben uve nangge ane um.
Ei gidawi givang be subu beleinge gisov luev be mank inme be en gikwai,
be ben uve subu gisov nalk tis vat, be nalk etok sisi ma, be ben gireu bemem wakas gisov nalk aplo gile ite.
Be givin ebe as gwang-ne givse taku ok be as ges love ainggwen be gimat.
Be subu gisov vwavwe aplo be vwavwe gireu love ges vunu be ben ges ano ite.
Be subu gisov nalk vie be gireu love ges ano vevies ge. Subu ges ano 30, be subu ges gitangi 60, be subu ges ano gitangi 100.”
Yisu ginei gitangi eisir; “Ginei talngangg-aim avo giengk okob unaute vevie.”
Yisu ane bingai ane dabe
Givin ebe Yisu ge givang ane atane-ngge ok, okob ete ane singamolomb-gen tis amolmol ebe ivang ivin ei ok itangi ei ile be iutani bingai nok ane dabe.

Beti Yisu ginei gitangi eisir be ginei, “Pomate ges ane kulkul ebe geb yem dabin ok ru gitangi yem gikwai, bemem amolmol ebe isov Pomate ane yaun ane lu ite ok, ete iute denang ebe bingai sin-gege ok.
Eisir ok ili be iute, bemem itpweng gen ti are ite. Dang-etok be ginei eisir inro isate vukir ite, atob Pomate nisin eisir as gen tiate ebe ilgum ok nikwai ite ma yapin.”
Bingai ben uve ane ane dabe
Bekob Yisu giutani eisir be ginei; “Yem utpweng bingai etok ane dabe are ite, be wali atob unatpweng bingai subu ane dabe are nam-nambed?
Unaute. Amol ebe gidawi ben uve ok ei gidawi Pomate ane mateu.
Be ben uve ebe gisov luev ok, ete weik amolmol ebe iute Pomate ane yaun, bemem itak giengk aplos ite be givin ebe iute mateu ok Sadam ginme be girwel gikwai eisir aplos painge ge ok.
Be amolmol subu ete weik ben uve ebe gisov nalk tis vat ok. Eisir iute mateu be tas vevias ge,
bemem yaun etok eisir itak giengk aplos ite ma, ve ginei gen bunam ti me amol ti ginei ninggo eisir ve Pomate ane mateu ane, atob eisir inavkir dumas nitangi Pomate seukie-ngge.
Be ben uve ebe gisov vwavwe aplo ok ete weik amolmol ebe iute Pomate ane mateu
bemem gen nalk ane geb eisir aplos avut be tas gitung mone be tas gitung gen utlas ulis ane gitlek molge ok.

Be amolmol ebe iute mateu be ipasang giengk aplos be tas givin ve inalgum ano nile ok, ete weik ben uve ebe gisov nalk vie ok. Be ben etok ete ges ano subu gitangi 30, be subu ges gitangi 60, be subu ges gitangi 100.
Bingai gipil lam ebe ivandung ve kilkiel ok
Be Yisu ginei bingai ti vukuri gitangi amolmol be ginei; “Yem utung lam be uvandung ve kilkiel ite ma. Yem uravi lam giengk gitip ge.
Be gen walang ete giengk givwaivun ate ok, atob niengk nitip ge, be gen walang ebe idbwem ok atob menihlang.
Amolmol talngas-avo ginei giengk okob inaute vevie.”

Be Yisu ginei; “Yaun ete yem ute nik tangg-aim nitung vevie-ngge. Ve gen ret ret ete yem ulgum gitangi amolmol subu ok, gen etok ge ete atob Pomate nilgum nitangi yem vukuri be atob ei nemb nitlek ete yem ulgum gitangi amolmol ok.
Amol ti ginei dabe gwet giengk atob nitpweng gen subu are nivin, be amol ti ginei dabe gwet ma atob nitpweng gen ti are ite molge.”
Bingai gipil ben uve ebe gireu ok
Be Yisu ginei, “Amolmol ebe Pomate geb is dabin ok weik amol ebe gidawi ben uve nangge ane um ok.
Ei giengk givin tambok, be as ei gimdil be givang. Be ben etok gireu love bamo be amol nok gitpweng are ite.
Nalk ei ate gilgum be ben gireu. Ben gireu aitine gimungg bekob vue gile bekob ete ano gile gikaiwel.
Ben etok ano be yu, okob um tivie atob nemb kulkul ve ninggas ane gen.
Bingai gipil wer sivsiev ano ane vatu
Yisu ginei gitangi eisir be ginei; “Ayeu atob nanei yaun nipil amolmol ebe Pomate geb is dabin ok, be nanei nipil bingai ge.
Pomate geb amolmol dabin weik wer sivsiev ano ane vatu. Wer sivsiev ano ane vatu nok, ei gen natu molge gitangi gen subu vatu ite.
Bemem tanavro nisov nalk nile be bwayage kob atob nireu love bamo nitlek ben subu, bekob atob niro range nile be mank inde inalgum as niu nile be inambweg ane tulu.”
Yisu ginei mateu be ginei gipil bingai ge
Yisu ginei mateu gitangi amolmol be ginei gipil bingai anongge gitangi ebe ve eisir inatpweng are ok.
Ei ginei yaun ti ano vusa gitangi eisir ite ma, ginei gipil bingai ge. Bemem bwayage be tis ane singamolomb-gen ivang as sawa ge kob ete ei ginei yaun walang etok lavo gitangi eisir.
Yisu ginei yaun ge gitangi wavin ane tine be bongong
Givin as-mate etok ane gibok Yisu ginei gitangi ane singamolomb-gen be ginei; “Eitit tanes gili tande tanpil bui kapul tavlu ane.”
Yisu tis ane singamolomb-gen ivang ikwai amolmol ebe ivarkei alus ok, be eivovo subu ivin eisir.
Givin etok wavin givang be ane tine bamo molge, be bui gikari gisov eivovo aplo.
Be Yisu ande gitak lopong be gisov be giengk ebe eivovo mul ok. Eisir singamolomb ile es ei itin be inei gitangi ei, “Mie guli ebe atob eitit tansov bui ok me ma?”
Yisu gimdil be ginei ve avo ge gitangi wavin tis ngal be ginei; “Kamoke!” Be wavin gituvi be ngal gitak love bongong vie molge.
Bekob girau lili be ginei gitangi ane singamolomb-gen be ginei, “Yem upelk dang-etok ve ret ane? Yem wat aplongg-aim givin ayeu ano molge ite me?”
Eisir singamolomb ande dalgos givang be inei ve isate be inei; “Amol ret dang-etenik, ete wavin tis ngal ok be iute ei ane yaun ge nik?”
